insights: 4,385 streamers share 37,304 mutual follows — density 0.0039: only ~0.39% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 3.024 hops apart (diameter ≥ 9).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 19% of all tie endpoints (max degree 1229 vs median 8).
Partner assortativity = -0.360: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.182: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 11 communities (modularity 0.34); the largest, C1, holds 20% of streamers.
C3 is the most 'professional' community: 16% Partners vs 11% overall.
C8 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (31% vs 25% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
124 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
178 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
